sanskrit: gṛṇe tadindra te śava upamāṃ devatātaye . yaddhaṃsi vṛtramojasā śacīpate
english: I praise that might of yours, O Indra, supreme among the divine — that by which you, O lord of power, smash Vṛtra with your strength.

sanskrit: yasya tyacchambaraṃ made divodāsāya randhayan . ayaṃ sa soma indra te sutaḥ piba
english: In whose exhilaration you subdued that Śambara for Divodāsa — this is that Soma, O Indra, pressed out for you; drink.

sanskrit: endra no gadhi priya satrājidagohya . girirna viśvataḥ pṛthuḥ patirdivaḥ
english: Come to us, O Indra, dear one, unconquerable winner of all, broad on every side like a mountain, lord of the sky.

sanskrit: ya indra somapātamo madaḥ śaviṣṭha cetati . yenā haṃsi nyā3triṇaṃ tamīmahe
english: That rapture of yours, O Indra, mightiest Soma-drinker, which wakens within you — by which you strike down the devourer — that we implore.

sanskrit: tuce tunāya tatsu no drādhīya āyurjīvase . ādityāsaḥ samahasaḥ kṛṇotana
english: For nourishment and vigor, grant us therefore a longer life to live. O Ādityas of equal power, make it so.

sanskrit: vetthā hi nirṛtīnāṃ vajrahasta parivṛjam . aharahaḥ śundhyuḥ paripadāmiva
english: For you, O thunderbolt-handed one, know how to ward off the snares of destruction, day by day, as the purifier wards off the encircling dangers.

sanskrit: apāmīvāmapa stridhamapa sedhata durmatim . ādityāso yuyotanā no aṃhasaḥ
english: Drive away disease, drive away the oppressor of the household, drive away ill will. O Ādityas, keep distress far from us.

sanskrit: pibā somamindra mandatu tvā yaṃ te suṣāva haryaśvādriḥ . soturbāhubhyāṃ suyato nārvā
english: Drink the Soma, O Indra; let it gladden you — the Soma that the stone has well-pressed for you, O driver of bay horses, well-drawn from the presser's arms like a swift steed.

sanskrit: yudhedāpitvamicchase
english: Even in battle you seek fellowship.

sanskrit: yo na idamidaṃ purā pra vasya ānināya tamu va stuṣe . sakhāya indramūtaye
english: Him who in former times brought us this and this abundance — him I now praise before you, O friends, Indra, for his protection.

sanskrit: ā gantā mā riṣaṇyata prasthāvāno māpa sthāta samanyavaḥ . dṛḍhā cidyamayiṣṇavaḥ
english: Come, do not be harmed, you who are ready to depart; do not fall back, you of equal zeal — you who strive to hold even what is firm.

sanskrit: ā yāhyayamindave 'śvapate gopate urvarāpate . somaṃ somapate piba
english: Come here for the Soma-drop, O lord of horses, lord of cattle, lord of fertile fields. Drink the Soma, O lord of Soma.

sanskrit: tvayā ha svidyujā vayaṃ prati śvasantaṃ vṛṣabha bruvīmahi . saṃsthe janasya gomataḥ
english: With you truly as ally, O bull, we would challenge the snorting foe in the gathering of the cattle-rich folk.

sanskrit: gāvaściddhā samanyavaḥ sajātyena marutaḥ sabandhavaḥ . rihate kakubho mithaḥ
english: Even the cows of equal zeal, the Maruts bound by common kinship, lick the peaks in turns.

sanskrit: tvaṃ na indrā bhara ojo nṛmṇaṃ śatakrato vicarṣaṇe . ā vīraṃ pṛtanāsaham
english: Bring us, O Indra, strength and manly power, O lord of a hundred plans, all-seeing one — a hero who can withstand battles.

sanskrit: adhā hīndra girvaṇa upa tvā kāma īmahe sasṛgmahe . udeva gmanta udabhiḥ
english: And so, O Indra, lover of hymns, we approach you in desire, we rush toward you — like waters rising upward to the heights.

sanskrit: sīdantaste vayo yathā gośrīte madhau madire vivakṣaṇe . abhi tvāmindra nonumaḥ
english: They settle in you as birds settle in a cow-enriched, sweet, intoxicating, spreading place. We bow before you again and again, O Indra.

sanskrit: vayamu tvāmapūrvya sthūraṃ na kaccidbharanto 'vasyavaḥ . vajriñcitraṃ havāmahe
english: We, too, O incomparable one, carrying you like some great unsupported load, desiring help, call upon you, O brilliant thunderbolt-bearer.

sanskrit: yā indreṇa sayāvarīrvṛṣṇā madanti śobhathā vasvīranu svarājyam
english: Those who together with Indra, the bull, exult in joy, the splendid ones rich in treasure — following him in his own sovereign rule.

sanskrit: itthā hi soma inmado brahma cakāra vardhanam . śaviṣṭha vajrinnojasā pṛthivyā niḥ śaśā ahimarcannanu svarājyam
english: For thus indeed this Soma-intoxication made the sacred word a source of increase. O mightiest thunderbolt-bearer, you cut the serpent out of the earth by your strength, singing praise — following your own sovereign rule.

sanskrit: indro madāya vāvṛdhe śavase vṛtrahā nṛbhiḥ . taminmahatsvājiṣūtimarbhe havāmahe sa vājeṣu pra no 'viṣat
english: Indra, the slayer of Vṛtra, has grown great with exhilaration and strength, with his heroes. We invoke his aid in great combats and in small — may he drive us forward to victories.

sanskrit: indra tubhyamidadrivo 'nuttaṃ vajrinvīryam . yaddha tyaṃ māyinaṃ mṛgaṃ tava tyanmāyayāvadhīrarcannanu svarājyam
english: For you alone, O Indra, O stone-wielder, O thunderbolt-bearer, is that valor unconquerable. Indeed with that your magic you slew that magic beast — singing praise, following your own sovereign rule.

sanskrit: prehyabhīhi dhṛṣṇuhi na te vajro ni yaṃsate . indra nṛmṇaṃ hi te śavo hano vṛtraṃ jayā apo 'rcannanu svarājyam
english: Go forward, rush on, be bold — your thunderbolt shall not be laid down. O Indra, for manly power is your strength; slay Vṛtra, win the waters — singing praise, following your own sovereign rule.

sanskrit: yadudīrata ājayo dhṛṣṇave dhīyate dhanam . yuṅkṣvā madacyutā harī kaṃ hanaḥ kaṃ vasau dadho 'smāṃ indra vasau dadhaḥ
english: When the battles break forth, wealth is bestowed on the bold one. Yoke your two bay steeds, shaken by rapture — whom will you strike? Whom will you place in wealth? Place us, O Indra, in wealth.

sanskrit: akṣannamīmadanta hyava priyā adhūṣata . astoṣata svabhānavo viprā naviṣṭhayā matī yojā nvindra te harī
english: They have eaten their fill, they have been gladdened; the beloved ones have bent down. The self-luminous poets have praised with the newest thought. Now yoke your two bay steeds, O Indra.

sanskrit: upo ṣu śṛṇuhī giro maghavanmātathā iva . kadā naḥ sūnṛtāvataḥ kara idarthayāsa idyojā nvindra te harī
english: Listen closely to these words, O bountiful one, as to a mother's. When will you render us, who possess true speech, to our purpose here? Now yoke your two bay steeds, O Indra.

sanskrit: candramā apsvā3ntarā suparṇo dhāvate divi . na vo hiraṇyanemayaḥ padaṃ vindanti vidyuto vittaṃ me asya rodasī
english: The moon within the waters, the fair-winged one runs through the sky. The lightnings with golden rims do not find your footprint. Know this, O heaven and earth, on my behalf.

sanskrit: prati priyatamaṃ rathaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vasuvāhanam . stotā vāmaśvināvṛśi stomebhirbhūṣati prati mādhvī mama śrutaṃ havam
english: The praiser adorns with his hymns your most beloved chariot, O Aśvins — the bull-like one, wealth-carrying. Hear my sweet invocation in return.

sanskrit: yuddha syā te panīyasī samiddīdayati dyavīṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara
english: That praiseworthy blazing one of yours glows in battle. Bring forth quickly for the praisers.

sanskrit: āgniṃ na svavṛktibhirhotāraṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe . śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ vi vo made yajñeṣu stīrṇabarhiṣaṃ vivakṣase
english: Like Agni, with our own hymns we choose you as the invoking priest — swift, of purifying flame. In your exhilaration you speak out in the sacrifices where the ritual grass is spread.

sanskrit: mahe no adya bodhayoṣo rāye divitmatī . yathā cinno abodhayaḥ satyaśravasi vāyye sujāte aśvasūnṛte
english: Awaken us today, O Uṣas, for great wealth, O celestial one. Just as you have awakened us, O one of true renown, O airy one, O well-born one, O dawn with horses and truth.

sanskrit: bhadraṃ no api vātaya mano dakṣamuta kratum . athā te sakhye andhaso vi vo made raṇā gāvo na yavase vivakṣase
english: Blow into us a blessed mind, discernment, and resolve. Then in your friendship, in the exhilaration of the Soma drink, you speak out — the cows rejoice as if at pasture.

sanskrit: kratvā mahāṃ anuṣvadhaṃ bhīma ā vāvṛte śavaḥ . śriya ṛṣva upākayorni śiprī harivāṃ dadhe hastayorvajramāyasam
english: By his might the great, terrible strength returns again and again in due course. The handsome one, with his helmet, set the iron thunderbolt in the hands of the two glorious ones nearby.

sanskrit: sa ghā taṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rathamadhi tiṣṭhāti govidam . yaḥ pātraṃ hāriyojanaṃ pūrṇamindrā ciketati yojā nvindra te harī
english: He indeed mounts that bull-like chariot that wins cattle — he who perceives the full bowl yoked with bay steeds. Now yoke your two bay steeds, O Indra.

sanskrit: agniṃ taṃ manye yo vasurastaṃ yaṃ yanti dhenavaḥ . astamarvanta āśavo 'staṃ nityāso vājina iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara
english: I regard as Agni the one who is a treasure-home, to whom the milch-cows go home, to whom the swift horses go home, the constant prize-winners. Bring nourishment quickly for the praisers.

sanskrit: na tamaṃho na duritaṃ devāso aṣṭa martyam . sajoṣaso yamaryamā mitro nayati varuṇo ati dviṣaḥ
english: No distress, no evil reaches that mortal, O gods, whom Aryaman, Mitra, and Varuṇa, with one accord, lead beyond hatred.

sanskrit: paryū ṣu pra dhanva vājasātaye pari vṛtrāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ . dviṣastaradhyā ṛṇayā na īrase
english: Run forth all around for the winning of prizes, overcoming obstacles on every side. You go to overcome enemies, as if to discharge a debt.

sanskrit: pavasva soma mahāntsamudraḥ pitā devānāṃ viśvābhi dhāma
english: Flow, O Soma, great as the ocean, the father of gods, encompassing all dwellings.

sanskrit: pavasva soma mahe dakṣāyāśvo na nikto vājī dhanāya
english: Flow, O Soma, for great discernment — like a horse rubbed clean, a prize-winner for wealth.

sanskrit: induḥ paviṣṭa cārurmadāyāpāmupasthe kavirbhagāya
english: The lovely drop has entered the filter, for exhilaration — the seer in the lap of the waters, for good fortune.

sanskrit: anu hi tvā sutaṃ soma madāmasi mahe samaryarājye . vājāṃ abhi pavamāna pra gāhase
english: For we rejoice in you, O pressed Soma, in the great sovereign rule of battle. You, O Pavamāna, plunge forward toward the prizes.

sanskrit: ka īṃ vyaktā naraḥ sanīḍā rudrasya maryā atha svaśvāḥ
english: Who are these manifest men, nest-mates, the youths of Rudra — then those with good horses?

sanskrit: agne tamadyāśvaṃ na stomaiḥ kratuṃ na bhadraṃ hṛdispṛśam . ṛdhyāmā ta ohaiḥ
english: O Agni, today with hymns, like a horse, may we succeed in that blessed resolve that touches the heart — may we thrive through your urgings.

sanskrit: āvirmaryā ā vājaṃ vājino agmaṃ devasya savituḥ savam . svargāṃ arvanto jayata
english: The youths have come forth, the prize-winning ones have come toward the prize at the impulsion of god Savitṛ. Win the heavenly track, O steeds.

sanskrit: pavasva soma dyumnī sudhāro mahāṃ avīnāmanupūrvyaḥ
english: Flow, O Soma, full of brilliance, of fine streams, great, unobstructed, in due order.

sanskrit: viśvatodāvanviśvato na ā bhara yaṃ tvā śaviṣṭhamīmahe
english: O all-giving one, bring to us from all sides — you whom we implore as most mighty.

sanskrit: eṣa brahmā ya ṛtviya indro nāma śruto gṛṇe
english: This is the sacred priest who is in season — I praise the one famed as Indra by name.
